description: The default alert resources of a data sink, created with it. They are ordinary alert definitions and notification sinks in the data sink namespace: edit them to change recipients, messages or cooldowns; the system never overwrites them.

errorAlertDefinition.description: The name of the alert definition raised (Critical) when the data sink goes to Error.
errorAlertDefinition.title: errorAlertDefinition

failingAlertDefinition.description: The name of the alert definition raised (Warning) when a run of the data sink keeps failing.
failingAlertDefinition.title: failingAlertDefinition

sink.description: The name of the default notification sink created with the data sink. Empty when no default notification sink was created.
sink.title: sink

status.description: Configured: a default notification sink was created for the alert definitions. NeedsRecipient: the alert definitions were created without a notification sink; configure a recipient or destination and add a sink to them to be notified.
status.title: status

title: DataSinkNotifications
